caption: Both trees are legal, so the PCFG multiplies rule probabilities: Parse A scores 0.2K and Parse B scores 0.6K. Parse B is chosen, three times more probable, though head words and word senses can still overrule it.

spec.title: I saw the man with the telescope
spec.aria: One sentence yields two legal parses; their probabilities 0.2K and 0.6K are compared and the higher one, Parse B, is chosen with a three-to-one ratio.
